result.reason: The redline adds the requested Licensor indemnity triggers and removes the IP-infringement disclaimer, but it does not reach the playbook position. It leaves Licensee’s indemnity broadly covering all exercise of licensed rights, business conduct, and contractual breaches rather than limiting it to Licensee-provided content and breach of law. It also omits notice, control-of-defense, settlement, and cooperation procedures. Licensor’s indemnity remains subject to the one-half-of-fees aggregate cap because only the damages exclusion is carved out, falling well below the 3× annual-fees fallback. Drafting is also structurally defective: the carveout refers to Licensor indemnification obligations “under Article XII,” while the new Licensor indemnity is placed after Article XIII.
